title: Automotive Service Advisor
description:
Automotive Service Advisor / Motor Trade Service Advisor

Location: Chelmsford, Essex

Salary: £28,000 - £34,000 per annum (depending on experience)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:30pm, plus one Saturday morning per month

Are you an experienced Automotive Service Advisor looking for a new opportunity within the motor trade?

We're recruiting on behalf of an established, award-winning independent automotive specialist in Chelmsford that's looking for a confident, organised and customer-focused Service Advisor to join its team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys being at the heart of a busy automotive workshop, building relationships with customers and ensuring everything runs smoothly from the initial booking through to vehicle collection.

You'll play an important role in connecting customers with the workshop team, managing service and repair bookings, preparing quotations and helping customers understand the work required on their vehicles.

If you have previous experience within a main dealership, prestige automotive specialist or independent garage, we'd love to hear from you.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £28,000 - £34,000, depending on experience
- Permanent, full-time employment
- Opportunity to join an established, award-winning independent automotive business
- Varied role combining customer service, workshop coordination and automotive knowledge
- 22 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Company pension scheme
- Employee discounts
- Private Healthcare
- Free on-site parking

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the first point of contact for customers, providing a friendly and professional service.
- Manage vehicle servicing, maintenance and repair bookings by telephone and online.
- Coordinate the workshop diary, working closely with technicians and workshop management.
- Prepare accurate quotations and estimates for servicing, repairs and additional work.
- Review Vehicle Health Checks (VHCs), clearly explaining any recommended repairs or maintenance to customers.
- Identify and source the correct vehicle parts, ensuring accurate pricing and labour estimates.
- Keep customers informed throughout the repair process, providing updates on progress and completion times.
- Recommend additional servicing and repair work where appropriate, helping maximise workshop efficiency and sales.
- Ensure customer records, bookings and job information are maintained accurately.
- Work closely with colleagues to maintain excellent customer satisfaction and smooth day-to-day workshop operations.

What We're Looking For
- At least 3 years' experience as a Service Advisor within the motor trade.
- Previous experience within a main dealership, independent garage or prestige automotive specialist.
- Good understanding of vehicle servicing, maintenance and mechanical repairs.
- Experience preparing repair quotations, processing Vehicle Health Checks and estimating labour requirements.
- Confidence communicating with customers about vehicle faults, repairs and recommended maintenance.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple bookings and enquiries.
- Good attention to detail and confidence using workshop booking or dealer management systems.
- A proactive, positive attitude and the ability to work effectively within a busy automotive environment.

Previous automotive Service Advisor experience is essential for this position.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Automotive Service Advisor, Motor Trade Service Advisor or Vehicle Service Advisor looking for a new opportunity in Chelmsford, we'd love to hear from you.

Whether you're currently working in a busy main dealership or an independent automotive workshop, this could be an excellent opportunity to join an established business where your experience and customer service skills will be valued.

Apply today to find out more about the position and discuss the opportunity in confidence.

title: Fitness to Practice Administrator
description:
Job Title: Fitness to Practice Administrator

Location: Chelmsford campus

Start Date: ASAP

Proposed End Date: 23rd December 2026

Hours: 37hrs per week

Rate of pay: 16.19ph

Job Purpose:

To coordinate and oversee the University's Fitness to Practise processes, ensuring cases are managed efficiently, consistently and in line with regulatory, professional and University requirements. The role provides specialist administrative support, manages complex casework, and drives process improvements to maintain a high-quality service.

Key Responsibilities:

Act as the principal administrator for Fitness to Practise processes, coordinating the end to end administration of cases and ensuring compliance with University regulations, professional standards and statutory requirements.

Maintain and oversee the central record of all Fitness to Practise concerns, ensuring information is accurately recorded, monitored and reported, and that appropriate audit trails are maintained.

Monitor case progression and proactively manage Fitness to Practise workflows, identifying key deadlines, escalating issues where appropriate, and ensuring cases are progressed in a timely manner.

Coordinate and administer Fitness to Practise panels and associated meetings, managing complex scheduling requirements and ensuring arrangements comply with procedural requirements.

Arrange and support initial review meetings and Fitness to Practise hearings, including the preparation of agendas, meeting documentation and Microsoft Teams arrangements.

Provide specialist administrative guidance to academic and professional services staff, students and practice partners on Fitness to Practise procedures and processes, referring complex matters as appropriate.

Communicate with students throughout the Fitness to Practise process, including requesting statements, providing procedural information and ensuring that required documentation is obtained within agreed timescales.

Coordinate meetings between students and the Professionalism Lead, ensuring relevant information is available to support effective discussion and decision making.

Collate, quality check and circulate Fitness to Practise documentation, ensuring panel members receive complete and accurate information within required timescales.

Support panel proceedings by preparing and distributing documentation, recording actions and ensuring outcomes are accurately documented and communicated.

Communicate panel outcomes, recommendations and associated actions to relevant stakeholders, including University staff, practice partners and external organisations, ensuring confidentiality and procedural compliance.

Prepare, distribute and maintain records of transcripts, summaries and formal correspondence arising from Fitness to Practise proceedings.

Liaise with practice partners and internal colleagues to identify, secure and coordinate panel membership, ensuring appropriate representation and adherence to panel requirements.

Produce and analyse management information relating to Fitness to Practise activity, identifying trends and providing reports to support operational planning and decision making.

Review and contribute to the development of administrative processes, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance efficiency, consistency and service delivery.

Requirements:

Experience relevant to the role

Previous experience of providing specialist knowledge

Experience of analysing and resolving problems through detailed manipulation and analysis of information

Experience of analysing data and writing reports

People Management

Excellent digital literacy and systems capability, with experience of evaluating and implementing digital solutions to improve processes, efficiency and service delivery.

Good understanding of the standards and regulations relating to relevant PSRBs

DESIRABLE:

Experience of low code/no code development (e.g. PowerAutomate)

How to apply: Please provide a CV and Cover letter confirming why you are suitable for the role.
